rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page text layer) sits beside or just above it. The sheet numbers items differently from the layout keys, so items are matched by caption text, not by key names. Amounts print the writer official text: a peso comb plus a 2-slot centavo comb where the sheet has one, otherwise one text cell. Booleans fill X in the box left of the printed option. Left out: MM and DD of Year Ended (no labels), the TIN branch comb, the shared item 10/11 comb, the MM/DD/YYYY date combs, the Part III grid (unnamed keys), and items with no fillable cell on the sheet.
